sections.title: Investment Recommendation
sections.text: Costco’s membership‑driven model delivers durable earnings, supported by a strong return on average equity [[COST.ratio.return_on_average_equity]]. Operating margins are modest yet stable [[COST.ratio.operating_margin]], and the balance sheet is conservative with low leverage. However, the price‑earnings multiple is elevated and execution risks around expansion, digital integration, cybersecurity and litigation are noted. Balancing durability against a premium valuation leads to a neutral stance.

insight.text: The company maintains a low leverage profile, reflecting conservative financing.
